meta.problem: A YouTube automation for kids videos that generates income: nursery rhyme stories for toddlers — scripts, titles and thumbnails, weekly.

agent.name: tiny-tots-rhymes-weekly
agent.model_rationale: Newest Opus-class — the default; creative quality and policy judgment matter more than speed, and a weekly run still costs cents.
agent.system_summary: Each week writes 3 nursery-rhyme story packs for toddlers (script with scene notes, title, description, tags, thumbnail image prompt, drawn thumbnail.png mockup) in a bright 2D cartoon style for the Tiny Tots Rhymes channel; checks and updates the memory store so rhymes and story angles never repeat; writes everything to /mnt/session/outputs/.
agent.style_reference: Super Simple Songs — style only (short, plain-English titles in the 'Song Name | Kids Songs' pattern, calm parent-facing descriptions, simple repetitive sing-along structure). Never copy its titles, lyrics, original songs, arrangements or characters.
never_dos: Never upload, post or publish anything — drafts only; the founder produces and uploads
Never use copyrighted characters, brands, modern songs or another channel's original songs or arrangements (including Super Simple Songs originals) — traditional public-domain rhymes only
Never write scary, unsafe-to-imitate or age-inappropriate content for toddlers
Never write misleading titles, thumbnails or descriptions

outcome.description: Produce this week's 3 Tiny Tots Rhymes story packs in /mnt/session/outputs/ and update the memory store.
rubric_criteria: 3 complete packs, each with: script (2-4 min, scene notes for bright 2D cartoon), YouTube title (<= 70 characters), description, tags, thumbnail image-generator prompt, and thumbnail.png mockup
Public-domain rhymes only — traditional rhymes; no copyrighted characters, brands or modern song lyrics
Toddler-appropriate — simple words, positive tone, nothing scary or unsafe to imitate; fits YouTube's 'made for kids' label
No repeats — none of the 3 rhymes or story angles already appears in the memory store, and the store is updated with this week's picks
Genuinely different — each pack has its own story angle, setting and lesson; not one template with names swapped
Honest metadata — titles and thumbnails match the content; no misleading clickbait

connections.notes: v0 delivers files only. v1: Google Drive (or email) delivery via MCP connector + vault credential.

stores.name: tiny-tots-rhymes-history
stores.purpose: Rhymes and story angles already used (with week), so each weekly run picks fresh ones.

schedule.kickoff: user.define_outcome (task + rubric above), relative dates only ('this week')

cases.name: case-01
cases.expected: This week's verified packs, saved at close (no golden set yet)

evals.notes: No past videos yet: the Outcome rubric is the per-run grader; the first verified run becomes case-01's expected output, the regression baseline for later agent versions. Super Simple Songs is a style reference only, not an answer key.

defaults_applied.write_actions: None — the agent drafts, the founder produces and uploads

interface.how: Packs land as session output files; download from the Console or Files API.

next_directions.what: Deliver packs to Google Drive (or as an email) automatically
next_directions.how: Google Drive MCP server + vault mcp_oauth credential; always_ask gate on writes
Text-to-speech API key in a vault (environment_variable credential); agent calls it from bash and saves narration.mp3 per pack

next_directions.what: Assemble a draft video (images + voiceover + captions)
next_directions.how: Image-generation API credential + ffmpeg in the environment packages; agent renders a rough-cut .mp4 per pack for the founder to review

next_directions.what: Upload to YouTube as private drafts
next_directions.how: YouTube Data API OAuth via a custom tool or MCP server + vault; always_ask gate; uploads as private, marked made-for-kids, founder publishes

next_directions.what: Learn from channel analytics (which rhymes and titles perform)
next_directions.how: YouTube Analytics API read access via vault credential; agent writes a weekly 'what worked' note into the memory store

next_directions.what: Re-run evals before promoting any new agent version to the deployment
next_directions.how: evals/run-evals.sh against the new version; only update the deployment when verdicts hold
